sip-proof-attempt-2-report.json.description: Byte-exact original failed diagnostic report including actual CLI output and bridge snapshots; CRLF transport bytes retained without Git normalization.

diagnosis.rootCause: The legacy Contact row regex uses a greedy whitespace group followed by a negative lookahead. For the actual multi-space header it backtracks, leaves whitespace before '<', and counts the column header as an extra contact. Captured PBX contact exactly matches the client address/port, and Objects found is 1.
diagnosis.offlineReproduction: Regression runs legacy matching on exact captured output and observes two rows, then corrected parsing returns the sole exact expected contact and rejects wrong-port/object-count inputs.
diagnosis.historicalBoundary: Attempt 1 lacks the actual row and remains unproven; matching symptoms do not retroactively establish its exact cause. Neither failed runtime report is edited or promoted to passed.

offlineFollowUp: Fix contact parsing by capturing a non-whitespace-starting value and excluding header values explicitly, with regression against exact runtime output.
Replace stopping the PID-1 Python preflight with a file-signalled zero exit. Attempt 2 recorded exit 137 without OOM after bounded Docker stop; no clean preflight exit is claimed for that execution.
Both follow-up changes were tested offline only; no third protocol attempt is authorized or executed. Original entrypoint and client snapshots matching executed hashes remain private.
